What to expect

Retreats at Trumbull Manor provide an opportunity to reflect on one’s everyday life in the light of basic Christian principles. An atmosphere of personal prayer and recollection is maintained during the retreat.
​
Each full day of the retreat includes Holy Mass and several conferences in the chapel, Exposition of the Blessed Sacrament and recitation of the Rosary. The priest conducting the retreat is available for the Sacrament of Reconciliation and for spiritual guidance.

​​Note: If you have already paid a deposit (initial payment), you may use the website to pay the balance by navigating to the event and selecting remaining payment.
